messages:
Alex M.: Quick check — Lume wants a hosted API key for their POC. They asked for 48h access to run stress tests. Can we issue a scoped key (model + rate limit) and what's the rotation/revoke playbook? 
Maria (SE): We can create a scoped key: project=acme-poc, models=[redwood-para-1], rate-limit=60rpm. TTL default 72h but I'd push for 24h. For POCs 48h is doable if Sales signs off and we add IP allowlist. 
Sam - Sales: NDA signed. Lume needs 48h specifically to run overnight load. They gave IPs: 52.23.1.0/24 and 3.5.7.9. Also want audit logs export. 
Ingrid (Sec): Prefer least privilege — 24h best practice. If you insist on 48h require NDA + IP allowlist + limit models and scopes. Audit logs are available; we can export session traces from Console (30d retention). Also require a rotation checklist in case of leak. 
Maria (SE): Plan: 1) Add IPs to allowlist; 2) Create scoped key via Console -> Create POC Key (set TTL=48h, scope:model+rate); 3) Share masked secret via 1Password, not Slack; 4) Set calendar reminder for rotation at 36h. 
Alex M.: Who can create the key? I can do it from Console if all approvals are in. 
Sam - Sales: Approving 48h for Lume. I'll add NDA confirmation in the thread and send the IPs to infra. 
Ingrid (Sec): Rotation/revoke playbook: create replacement key with identical scope, provide to customer via 1Password, confirm successful swap, then revoke old key. Emergency revoke = Console -> Keys -> Revoke (or `redwood keys revoke <key-id>` for CLI). All revokes produce an audit event with requestor id. 
Maria (SE): Example usage snippet to give customer (mask the secret in docs):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***REDACTED***" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Share real key only in 1Password. 
Alex M.: If customer says key leaked: immediate revoke, create replacement, open security ticket @Ingrid (Sec). 
deploy-bot: create_key job queued for project acme-poc — ETA ~4m :white_check_mark: 
Sam - Sales: I'll post the 1Password share when deploy-bot confirms. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
